content:
The test image shows a single, severely curled and crumpled dark brown/black leaf or shoot — completely desiccated and twisted. This matches **Cutting_Weevil** very closely: "Young leaves turn brown, curl and crumple; shoots are visibly stripped."

Die_Back is possible but typically shows gum secretion from twigs/branches and bark discoloration, not a single curled leaf. The Sooty_Mould reference shows black coating on green leaves — very different from this dried, curled specimen.

This matches the KB description closely and is distinct from Die_Back (which affects twigs/bark with gum secretion) or Sooty_Mould (black coating on otherwise green leaves)."}
